20261119-chemistry-g07.material: A zafin da bai canza ba, an ƙara matsin gas mai girman 60 mL a 1 atm zuwa 3 atm. Bisa Dokar Boyle, menene girman wannan gas ɗin?
20261119-chemistry-g07.thinking.0: A zafin da bai canza ba
20261119-chemistry-g07.s.s1.prompt: A zafin da bai canza ba, an ƙara matsin gas mai girman 60 mL a 1 atm zuwa 3 atm. Bisa Dokar Boyle, menene girman wannan gas ɗin?
20261119-chemistry-g07.s.s1.explain: Bisa Dokar Boyle, idan zafi bai canza ba, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

20261122-chemistry-g07-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Saurin diffusion mai zurfi don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.material: [Saurin diffusion mai zurfi] An saka auduga da aka jiƙa da concentrated ammonia water (nauyin ƙwaya 17) da auduga da aka jiƙa da concentrated hydrochloric acid (nauyin ƙwaya 36.5) a ƙarshen biyun dogon bututun gilashi a lokaci guda aka rufe da tsinken roba. Bayan ɗan lokaci, farin hayaƙi (ammonium chloride) ya bayyana a cikin bututun; a ina matsayinsa zai fi kusa?
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.s.s1.prompt: [Saurin diffusion mai zurfi] An saka auduga da aka jiƙa da concentrated ammonia water (nauyin ƙwaya 17) da auduga da aka jiƙa da concentrated hydrochloric acid (nauyin ƙwaya 36.5) a ƙarshen biyun dogon bututun gilashi a lokaci guda aka rufe da tsinken roba. Bayan ɗan lokaci, farin hayaƙi (ammonium chloride) ya bayyana a cikin bututun; a ina matsayinsa zai fi kusa?
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.s.s1.explain: Saurin diffusion na gas yana da alaƙa mai juyawa da tushen murabba'in nauyin ƙwaya. Gas ɗin ammonia mai sauƙin nauyin ƙwaya 17 yana tafiya da sauri fiye da gas ɗin hydrogen chloride mai nauyi (36.5), don haka yana yin reaction a wuri mafi kusa da audugar hydrochloric acid wadda take tafiya a hankali, kuma a nan ne farin hayaƙi yake bayyana.

20261122-chemistry-g07-1.s.s1.hint.1: Ammonia (17) ya fi hydrogen chloride (36.5) sauƙi sosai.

20261121-chemistry-g08-2.material: Don tabbatar da ko akwai chloride ion (Cl⁻) a cikin ruwan famfo wanda ya rage a matsayin by-product na kashe ƙwayoyin cuta, wane reagent ne za a digo, kuma menene sinadari na farin precipitate da ake samarwa?
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.thinking.0: wane reagent ne za a digo
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: Don tabbatar da ko akwai chloride ion (Cl⁻) a cikin ruwan famfo wanda ya rage a matsayin by-product na kashe ƙwayoyin cuta, wane reagent ne za a digo, kuma menene sinadari na farin precipitate da ake samarwa?
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.explain: Idan silver ion ($\text{Ag}^+$) na silver nitrate solution ya yi reaction da chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) na cikin ruwa, yana samar da farin silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) precipitate wanda ba ya narkewa a ruwa, don haka ana iya gano chloride ion.
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.hint.0: Idan silver ion (Ag⁺) da chloride ion (Cl⁻) sun haɗu, ana samar da farin precipitate da ba ya narkewa a ruwa.
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.hint.1: Reaction na precipitate: Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl↓

20261122-chemistry-g08-2.material: Yayin lantarkin ruwa (electrolysis) da ɗan electrolyte, wane haɗin iskar gas da ke fita a kan sandar (-) da sandar (+) da kuma rabon girmansu daidai ne?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: Yayin lantarkin ruwa (electrolysis) da ɗan electrolyte, wane haɗin iskar gas da ke fita a kan sandar (-) da sandar (+) da kuma rabon girmansu daidai ne?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.explain: Bisa lissafin electrolysis na ruwa $2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)$, a kan sandar (-) inda rage-ƙarfi (reduction) ke faruwa ana samun hydrogen $2$ girma, kuma a kan sandar (+) inda oxidation ke faruwa ana samun oxygen $1$ girma.
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.hint.0: Tsarin sinadarin ruwa shi ne H₂O (atom 2 na hydrogen da atom 1 na oxygen).
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.o.o0: Sandar (-): hydrogen (H₂),  sandar (+): oxygen (O₂),  rabon girma = 2 : 1

20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.o.o2: Sandar (-): hydrogen (H₂),  sandar (+): chlorine (Cl₂),  rabon girma = 1 : 1
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.o.o3: Sandar (-): tururin ruwa,  sandar (+): nitrogen,  rabon girma = 2 : 1
